# Path corpus: "<expected>\t<cwd>\t<command>", resource host "db.internal".
# Expected: "r:<ref>" / "w:<ref>" (PathRef.String()), "?" for an unresolved path, "-" for no paths; order does not matter.
# A line that starts with "# " followed by a section name opens that section.
# read
r:/var/log/syslog	~	cat /var/log/syslog
r:~/app/config.yml	~	cat app/config.yml
r:/srv/app/x	/srv/app	cat x
r:~	~	ls
r:/srv/**	~	find /srv -name '*.log'
r:/etc/hosts	~	head -n 5 /etc/hosts
r:~/a.txt	~	grep -e foo a.txt
r:~/b.txt	~	grep foo b.txt
r:/srv/**	~	grep -r TODO /srv
r:~/**	~	grep -R TODO
r:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf	~	sed -n '1,20p' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
r:~/app/a r:~/app/b	~/app	diff a b
r:/srv/**	~	du -sh /srv
r:/srv/x r:~/prog.awk	~	awk -f prog.awk /srv/x
r:~/app/data.json	~/app	jq .name data.json
r:~/a	~	cat - a
r:/srv/app	~	ls -la /srv/app/
r:/srv/**	~	ls -R /srv
r:~/backup.tar.gz	~	tar tzf backup.tar.gz
r:~/in.txt	~	uniq -f 2 in.txt
# write
r:~/app/a w:~/app/b/**	~	cp app/a app/b
w:~/a w:~/b/**	~	mv a b
w:/srv/app/build/**	~	rm -rf /srv/app/build
w:/srv/old/**	~	rm --rec /srv/old
r:~/a.tgz w:/srv/dist/**	~	tar -xzf a.tgz -C /srv/dist
r:/srv/** w:~/backup.tgz	~	tar czf backup.tgz /srv
w:/tmp/**	~	scp -t /tmp
r:/data	~	rsync --server --sender . /data
w:/srv/app/a	~	sed -i s/a/b/ /srv/app/a
w:/srv/app/**	~	chmod -R 755 /srv/app
w:/srv/a.conf	~	chmod -w /srv/a.conf
w:/srv/x/**	~	chown -R www-data /srv/x
r:/etc/ref w:~/f	~	chmod --reference=/etc/ref f
r:~/data.txt w:/tmp/sorted.txt	~	sort -o /tmp/sorted.txt data.txt
r:~/in.txt w:~/out.txt	~	uniq in.txt out.txt
r:/dev/zero w:/dev/sda	~	dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda
r:~/ref w:~/f	~	touch -r ref f
w:/tmp/x	~	echo x | tee /tmp/x
r:/etc/a w:/srv/**	~	cp -t /srv /etc/a
r:~/a.zip w:~/**	~	unzip a.zip
w:~/d1 w:~/d2	~	install -d d1 d2
w:/etc/hosts	~	vim /etc/hosts
r:~/a w:/srv/**	~	cp a /srv
w:~/x.key w:/srv/**	~	mv x.key /srv
r:~/f w:/srv/**	~	install f /srv
r:~/x w:/srv/**	~	ln -s x /srv
r:~/a r:~/b w:/dst/**	~	cp a b /dst/
r:~/a w:~/dst/**	~	scp a dst
w:/data/**	~	rsync --server . /data
r:~/data.txt w:/tmp/x	~	sort --out /tmp/x data.txt
r:~/data.txt w:/tmp/t	~	sort --temp /tmp/t data.txt
r:~/f w:/tmp/l	~	less --log-f /tmp/l f
r:/srv r:~/a.tar w:/srv/**	~	tar --dir /srv -x --file a.tar
r:~/src/** w:/dst/** w:/tmp/l	~	rsync -a --log /tmp/l src /dst
# redirect
w:/tmp/out	~	echo ok > /tmp/out
r:/etc/hosts	~	sort < /etc/hosts
r:/srv	~	ls /srv 2>/dev/null
r:~ w:~/out	~	ls >> out
w:~/log	~	echo x &> log
w:/srv/out	/srv	echo x >| out
r:/etc/hosts w:/tmp/h	~	cat < /etc/hosts > /tmp/h
-	~	echo ok > /dev/null 2>&1
# cd
w:/srv/app/build	~	cd /srv/app && rm build
r:/srv/x	~	(cd /srv && cat x)
?	~	cd /srv; rm b
w:/srv/b	~	cd /srv && rm b
r:/srv/a r:~/x	~	(cd /srv && cat a); cat x
?	~	cd /srv || cat x
?	~	cd /srv | cat x
?	~	cd /srv & cat x
?	~	! cd /srv && cat x
?	~	cd app && cat x
r:~/app/x	~	cd ./app && cat x
r:/srv/x	/srv/app	cd .. && cat x
r:~/x	/srv	cd && cat x
?	~	cd $D && cat x
?	~	cd - && cat x
?	~	cd ../.. && cat x
r:/x	~	cd /srv; cat /x
r:/srv/x	~	{ cd /srv; } && cat x
?	~	if true; then cd /srv; fi; cat x
?	~	pushd /srv && cat x
# glob
r:/var/log/**	~	cat /var/log/*.log
w:~/**	~	rm -f *
r:/srv/**	~	ls /srv/{a,b}
w:/srv/app/**	~	rm /srv/app/*/cache
r:~/logs/**	~	cat logs/*.txt
r:/**	~	cat /*
r:~/**	~	cat ~/*.txt
r:~/a*b	~	cat 'a*b'

?	~	cat $FILE
? r:~	~	ls | xargs rm -f
?	~	cat ~bob/notes
? r:~/list	~	cat $(cat list)
?	~	cat ../x
?	~	cat ~/../x
?	~	cat ~"/x"
?	~	cat ~$U/x
?	~	cat $'/etc/x'
?	~	cat "/srv/$F"

?	~	dd of=~/x
?	~	cat < $F
?	~	cat a=~/x
?	~	ls -l $DIR
?	~	head -n $N /etc/hosts
# wrappers
w:/etc/hosts	~	sudo tee /etc/hosts
r:/srv/x	~	bash -c 'cat /srv/x'
r:~/x	~	env LANG=C cat x
?	~	env -C /srv cat x
?	~	sudo -D /srv cat x
?	~	sudo -i cat x
?	~	sudo bash -c 'cat ~/x'
r:~/x	~	sudo cat ~/x
?	~	su -c 'cat ~/x' root
?	~	su - root -c 'cat x'
w:/tmp/x/**	~	timeout 5 rm -rf /tmp/x
r:/srv/x	~	nohup cat /srv/x

? r:~/list.txt	~	xargs -0 rm -rf < list.txt
?	~	HOME=/srv cat ~/x
?	~	CDPATH=/srv cat x

r:~/deploy.sh	~	./deploy.sh prod

r:/usr/bin/env r:~/x	~	/usr/bin/env cat x
